# Plivo

Plivo provides programmable voice, messaging, phone number, SIP, verification, and communications APIs.

Category: Communication. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/plivo/.

## Actions

- **Get Account Details** (read-only): Return billing, credit, timezone, and account-type details for the connected Plivo account.
- **Get Message** (read-only): Retrieve one existing Plivo message by its message UUID, including delivery, routing, timing, error, and billing details when available.
- **Get Usage Summary** (read-only): Return one page of Plivo spend and usage grouped by hour, day, month, or year for a required date range, with optional usage filters.
- **List Calls** (read-only): Return one page of Plivo call history, optionally filtered by time, direction, status, participants, hangup details, parent call, or…
- **List Messages** (read-only): Return one page of inbound and outbound Plivo message history, optionally filtered by time, direction, state, sender, recipient, type, or…
- **List Owned Numbers** (read-only): Return one page of phone numbers currently owned by the connected Plivo account, optionally filtered by prefix, type, service, alias, or…
